text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has become a total<n>laughingstock
online. Intending to<n>make everyone eat their words,
she<n>buckles down during summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus, on the other hand, is<n>down in the
dumps after a streak of<n>losses. At this very
moment,<n>however...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy swoops in and plays a<n>prank on her.
Her mood lightened,<n>Biko Pegasus realizes that
Shinko<n>Windy isn't the villain she's made<n>out to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Camp is underway and the Japan<n>Dirt Derby is fast
approaching—a<n>fervid summer is about to begin!
